authority: PREREG_V2G §3 (scoring rule) and §4.4 (one search config, S_AB fixed from search-only dev behaviour before any arm is scored); lanes/runtime.md §2, §4, §5
booster: no search pack: the core plays one-pass (lanes/runtime.md §6)
harness: scripts/v2g/dev_eval.py run_task: G<S_AB>[k<k_max>] (core-gated) and N<S_AB>[k<k_max>] (search_only); populations P = v2g:T4|T4b --ab-pick 2, X = t4x (salt v2g-eval-t4x-v0), tertiary = v2g:T_reg --ab-pick 1
note: CANDIDATE search config (not the Phase-1 A/B, which is v0 = runtime_search_config.json): v0 + belief v1b, which passed its preregistered criteria (lanes/runtime.md §5c)
rr: no search pack: the core plays one-pass (lanes/runtime.md §6)
s_ab_rule: declared before the N50k/N100k/N200k quality data: the largest budget in {50k, 100k, 200k} whose p95 wall latency is <= 100 ms on scripts/v2g/latency.py (lat_v1: 25k 51, 50k 69, 100k 98, 200k 150, 300k 192 ms p95; 1 core, uncached, contended host) -> 100,000

snake.pick: deterministic hash tie (the request carries the tick)

zoo.core_gate: conf = core p_opt at the prior's pick inside A; open iff conf >= tau and supported
zoo.deadline_role: serving cap only: reported as stats.over_deadline, never consulted
zoo.pick: draw from the returned distribution with the episode policy stream (PREREG_V2G §3): uniform over the exact tie set -> one integers(|A|) (support in increasing joint order); gated core prior inside A -> one random(), inverse CDF over the same order
zoo.tau_rule: per arm: scripts/v2g/gate_calib.py --sets v2g:NI_opus at S_AB with the arm's final checkpoint; tau = gate_calib.tau_rule(by_tau): smallest tau in (0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.98) with precision >= 0.95 and family-t lift CI lower bound > 0, else 1.01 (off)
